notes: Seed URL co.ellis.tx.us/index.asp?nid=312 and every co.ellis.tx.us page tried (/312/Elections, home) returned HTTP 403 (bot protection, not bypassed). One web search found the county's current domain www.elliscountytx.gov, which loads; its Prior Election Results pages link per-election pages. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Election-night results are hosted on livevoterturnout.com ENR (ellistxenr/4 and /5 for the 2026 primary, /9 and /10 for the runoff), which shows per-precinct results; the pages now show 'Official Results for Canvass' with 'Website Updated: 3/10/2026 2:10:56 PM' (Last-Modified Tue, 10 Mar 2026 19:10:57 GMT) and expose no dated update history, so check 1 cannot be read. County pages now list only official canvass PDFs (Official Cumulative/Summary Results, Official Precinct by Race Results, reconciliation forms) for all three elections; the election-night unofficial results have been replaced, so check 2 cannot show what was public on election night. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data not present).
tag_rationale: No election could be determined by checks 1 or 2 (election-night pages replaced by canvass results, check 3 pending), so the rule gives UNKNOWN.

Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: May 26, 2026 page lists 'Republican Party Official Runoff Results for Canvass (Link)' (livevoterturnout ENR /9) and official canvass PDFs only. Check 3 pending.
